title: Kenyan Garlic Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry dish inspired by Kenyan cuisine, made with fermented and crispy elements.

ingredients.name: Stir-fry oil
ingredients.notes: such as sesame or peanut oil

ingredients.name: Kenyan spices
ingredients.notes: such as berbere or kashata spices

instructions: Heat the stir-fry oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and tomato, and cook for 3-4 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Add the shredded fermented cabbage, crispy chickpeas, and Kenyan spices, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the cabbage is heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
Garnish with additional crispy chickpeas and chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Enjoy as a main dish or as a side.
